description: This PHP class 'EmailsNonImportedDetailView' extends 'EmailsDetailView' and is responsible for setting up and populating email detail views, particularly handling non-imported emails within the SuiteCRM email module. It manages the display and data population for email records that are not imported, including fetching inbound email records and handling request parameters.

classes.name: EmailsNonImportedDetailView
classes.description: A class that extends 'EmailsDetailView' to handle the display and data population for non-imported email details in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the detail view with specified module, focus, template, and metadata file.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the focus bean with email data based on request parameters, fetching inbound email records and handling missing parameters.
